title: Ho Chi Minh's letter to the US president with a copy of a Vietnamese constitution

tellings.quote: hoim men sent an impassion letter to our president and what he said in the letter is here's a copy of our uh our national Constitution it was identical to ours

plain: In the late 1940s the Vietnamese leader Ho Chi Minh is said to have sent an impassioned letter to the US president with a copy of Vietnam's national constitution, which was identical to America's. The remote viewer Joe McMoneagle, someone trained to describe distant things by mind alone, tells Michels this in passing, as a sign that a chance at friendship was missed.
